title: Dr Frost Arctic Blue Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Dr Frost Arctic Nic Salt Blue Ice delivers the juicy, sweet taste of ripe Blueberries perfectly complemented by a bracing wave of arctic menthol on the exhale. This simple yet vibrant blend combines the rich juicy sweetness of Blueberries with an eye-opening crisp, cool exhale, making it an ideal choice for vapers who enjoy fruity e-liquids with a frosty twist. As part of Dr Frost’s Arctic Edition collection, this nicotine salt e-liquid is crafted with a double-concentrated Bar Salts flavour, offering the same bold and intense taste vapers enjoy from disposable vapes. With a 50VG/50PG ratio, Blue Ice Nic Salt is designed for Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) pod kits and low-powered devices, providing smooth throat hits and quick nicotine satisfaction. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, Blue Ice offers a versatile and refreshing option for adult smokers and vapers seeking fruity and icy flavour combinations.
